name: Ending Choice Rehearsal Stage
blurb: Workshop tool, not a game region: a rehearsal stage for the Chapter 5 finale moment — the choice that sets ending.rain or ending.quiet. Mounts the shipped dialogue box, the shipped chapter-outro debrief card and the live title-screen epilogue panels in one scrollable timeline, drives the real save flags, slow-reads both epilogue drafts at broadcast pace with a radio-static bed, and statically audits every mission + choice tree to prove no content can set both endings. Anchors and centre live far outside the playable map.
